# QoF v1.5.3's Changelog

> [!NOTE]
> A Minecraft Bedrock addon that adds small vanilla-friendly features. Each module is configurable through the in-game pack settings panel. Requires **BetaAPIs** enabled under Experiments.

## Changelogs

- all images now use `jsDelivr` instead of `raw GitHub URLs`
- most settings have been simplified into a dropdown

<img src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/aitji/QoF@sources/.github/img/settings/v1.5.3.png" alt="QoF addon v1.5.3 settings">

### Battering Bat

- world hosts can now enable or disable battering bat from the settings panel

### Cache

- the `keepInventory` gamerule is now cached instead of being checked every time an entity dies

### Dynamic Light

> bug ref
> 
> `fixed` lights sometimes failing to reload or disappear correctly after chunk unloading, player login, host relogging, or world reloading

### Harvest

- sweet berry bushes can now be harvested

### Bug Fixes

- `fixed` lights sometimes failing to reload or disappear correctly after chunk unloading, player login, host relogging, or world reloading
